up: Retrieve distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), compound names (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures) for all molecules that are associated with the document whose chembl_id is 'CHEMBL4433236'. Only include molecules where the canonical SMILES is available (not null). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID, then by compound name, then by canonical SMILES in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4433236' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
